step.cmd: Determine which type of benefits was paid to the client the week of the date of death:

ul.li: If the client was paid regular benefits, go to step 31.
If the client was paid special benefits, go to step 33.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.

Work item: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is not in MPS, select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
If the claim is in MPS, select 93 - Manual Pay System .

Work Type: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is not in MPS, select 24 - Cancelled payment .
If the claim is in MPS, select 43 - Cancelled payment .
Remarks lines 1 and 2: Type “Deceased client. Cancel the following payment(s) in SPS and adjust the claim file:”
Remarks lines 2 and 3: Type “T071 type [2 for the current year or 8 for the previous year]/rsn F/ WC XXXX. CT XX/GB XXXX/FT XX/net XXXX/PRN XXXXXXXXXXXX.”

Remarks line 4: If necessary, type “ Amend the original claimant’s report to include the number of days the client was unavailable. Reissue the payment for WC XXXX and change the CS to 7 - Deceased .”
Remarks line 5: Type your first and last name.
Decision Type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Go to step 35.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.

Work item: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is not in MPS, select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
If the claim is in MPS, select 93 - Manual Pay System .

Work Type: Select the appropriate option:
If the claim is not in MPS, select 24 - Cancelled payment .
If the claim is in MPS, select 43 - Cancelled payment .
Remarks lines 1 and 2: Type “deceased client. Cancel the following payment(s) in SPS and adjust the claim file.”
Remarks lines 2 and 3: Type “T071 type [2 for the current year or 8 for the previous year]/rsn F/ WC XXXX.”
Remarks line 3: Type “CT XX/GB XXXX/FT XX/net XXXX/PRN XXXXXXXXXXXX.”
Remarks line 4: If necessary, type “Impose a DE39 as of [day after the date of death] to 9999. Reissue the payment for WC XXXX and change the CS to 7 - Deceased .”
Remarks line 5: Type your name and telephone number.
Decision Type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction to transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if there is an outstanding OP on file:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 37.
If no, go to step 41.

step.cmd: Determine if proof of death was received from the CRA:

ul.li: If no, go to step 38.
If yes, go to step 41.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and print locally the Z-00-00-00 letter to notify the CRA of the client’s death. Unless specified, select the most appropriate option for each of the following attributes:

ul.li: Employer or Third Party Name (1334): Type “NVCC Shawinigan Estates and Assessment Unit.”
Employer or Third Party Address 1 (1336): Type “Accounts Receivable, Government Programs Division, CRA.”
Employer or Third Party Address 2 (2440): Select Employer or Third Party Address Line 2 .
Employer or Third Party Address 2 (1338): Type “4695 Shawinigan-Sud Boulevard.”
Employer or Third Party Address 3 (2441): Select Address in Canada.
Employer or Third Party City (1340): Type “Shawinigan.”
Employer or Third Party Province or State (1342): Type “QC.”
Employer or Third Party Postal Code or Zip Code (1344): Type “G9P 5H9.”

step.cmd: In Imaging, print a copy of the proof of death.
Attach the paper documents to the printed Z-00-00-00 letter and send them to the CRA.
